title: Flags
info: A flag is a symbol of a country or a group.
The flag of Bangladesh is green with a red circle. The red circle sits a little toward the hoist, the side by the pole.
Japan's flag is white with a red circle. The colors around the circle help you tell the two flags apart.

questions.q: The hoist side of a flag is
options: The side farthest from the pole always called the sky
